description_en: Queries the list of database anti-ransomware policies
description_zh: 查询数据库防勒索策略列表
name: DescribeUniBackupPolicies

parameters.help_en: The name of the database anti-ransomware backup policy
parameters.help_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略的名称
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to display per page for a paginated query. The default number of entries per page is 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
> We recommend that you do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number from which to start displaying query results. Default value: **1**, which indicates that query results are displayed starting from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page
